protocol.threshold_policy: 0.5 fixed a priori; the full empirical curve is descriptive and must not select the reported threshold.
protocol.label_policy: Expected dimensions provide partial positives; other roles are proxy negatives only.
protocol.unlabeled_policy: Unlabeled cases enter agreement and latency only, never recall, excess, calibration, or threshold curves.
protocol.case_probability: Maximum P(true) over all hunks of a complete case.
protocol.choice_selection: Argmax per hunk, with catalog-order tie break; union across the case.
protocol.missing_policy: Incomplete, failed, duplicate, or blocked cases never become negative predictions.
protocol.llm_validation_scope: Accepted under limited citation checks: registered role, hunk ID, exact supplied path and line, snippet occurrence, tier/effort and reason constraints. Frozen hunk inputs omit base/candidate bindings, so side claims are unverified. This is not full schema/evidence conformance or proof of semantic reviewer relevance.
